name: gh Focus
description: For GitHub repos: the issue, pull request and Actions runs of the workspace you're in, beside your code. Read, comment, review and rerun without leaving the editor for the Tasks page. Uses the gh CLI; not affiliated with GitHub.

cover.alt: gh Focus: your workspace's issue and PR, beside the code. The panel's issue and pull request, with an Actions run in progress

screenshots.alt: gh Focus showing the workspace's linked issue with its labels, milestone and description
screenshots.caption: The workspace's issue, beside your work

screenshots.alt: gh Focus showing the workspace's merged pull request with its branches, checks, reviewers and description
screenshots.caption: Its pull request: branches, checks and review
